newsitem.title: CHINA: CITIC PACIFIC RISES ON LAGGARD BUYING.
newsitem.headline: CITIC PACIFIC RISES ON LAGGARD BUYING.

text.p: Shares of CITIC Pacific Ltd rose on Friday afternoon as investors took speculation that CNAC might buy a stake in Cathay from CITIC as an excuse to hunt for laggards, brokers said.
Brokers said rumours had been circulating that China National Aviation Corp (CNAC) might buy a stake in Cathay Pacific Airways Ltd from CITIC.
"People are taking the CNAC rumours as an excuse to buy CITIC, a stock which has lagged behind the market," said a sales manager at a regional brokerage.
CITIC shares, bucking a mild pull-back in the market after the recent rally, rose HK$1.10 to HK$51 in late trade. Volume was 12.16 million shares worth HK$617.56 million.
CNAC had said on Thursday it was not currently interested in acquiring a stake in the Hong Kong carrier.
